αἰνὰ: αἰνός — dread, terrible; neut. acc. pl.
αἰὲν: αἰεί — always, ever; adv., epic by-form αἰέν (Attic ἀεί)
αἴσιμον: αἴσιμος — fated, due, fitting; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’it was fated’, with an infinitive
αἵματος: αἷμα — blood; neut. gen. sg., with ἆσσον ’nearer to’
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὴ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. nom. sg.: ’she herself’, ’you yourself’ · also fem. nom. sg., of a thing: ’it itself’ (αὐτὴ δὲ χθαμαλὴ κεῖται ’and the island itself lies low’) · also intensive, 1st person: ’I myself’ (οἶδα καὶ αὐτή ’I know it myself’)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg.: ’himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼν αὐτός) · also masc. nom. sg. with a 2nd-person subject: ’yourself’ (εἰδήσεις δὲ καὶ αὐτός ’you will see for yourself’)
αὐτῆς: αὐτός — self; fem. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own works’): ’of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. governed by ἄγχι ’near, close to’: ’her’ (ἄγχι δ’ αὐτῆς ’close beside her’) · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a ship, fem.), governed by a noun: χρεὼ ... αὐτῆς ’a need of it’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a raft, fem.), governed by a preposition: ἐπ’ αὐτῆς ’upon it’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’her’, possessive with a noun: νόος ... αὐτῆς ’her mind’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’her’, governed by a preposition, of a monster: ἀπ’ αὐτῆς ’away from her’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of the olive), governed by ἀγχόθι ’near’: ἀγχόθι δ’ αὐτῆς ’and near it’ · also intensive with a noun, fem. gen. sg.: αὐτῆς Ἰθάκης ’Ithaca itself’
αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
αὖτε: αὖτε — again, in turn, on the other hand; adv.
βάλλεο: βάλλω — throw, put; mid. put (in one’s mind); pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -εο (= Attic βάλλου)
βίας: βία — force, violence; fem. acc. pl.: ‘acts of violence’
βουλήν: βουλή — plan, counsel, decision; acc. sg. · also council, assembly: ’council-meeting’ (ἐς βουλήν ’to the council’)
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γέροντι: γέρων — old man; masc. dat. sg.
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γενέσθαι: γίγνομαι — become, be born; aor. inf.: ’to have been born’ · also of time, ’come, arrive, come to pass’ (πρὶν δωδεκάτην γε γενέσθαι ’before the twelfth day should come’)
γυναικῶν: γυνή — woman; fem. gen. pl., partitive with δῖα: ’heavenly-one of women’ · also partitive with ἀρίστη: ’best of women’ · also possessive gen. with a noun: ἔργα γυναικῶν ’the works of women’
γόοιο: γόος — wailing, lament; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
δάκρυον: δάκρυον — tear; neut. acc. sg., by-form of δάκρυ
δεῦρ: δεῦρο — hither, here; adv., elided (δεῦρ’ = δεῦρο)
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: διὰ … τινάξῃ = διατινάξῃ ’shake apart, shatter’ · also + acc., causal, ’through, thanks to, by the aid of’ (διὰ … Ἀθήνην) · also as adverb/preverb in tmesis with κοσμηθέντες (διὰ … κοσμηθέντες = διακοσμηθέντες ’drawn up in divisions’) · also + gen., ’through, among’ (διὰ μήλων ’among the flocks’) · also prep. + gen., ’through’ (διὰ πτόλιος ’through the city’)
διὶ: Ζεύς — Zeus, chief of the gods; masc. dat. sg.
δμώων: δμώς — slave, bondman (esp. war-captive); masc. gen. pl.
δοιὰ: δοιοί — two, a pair of; numeral adj., neut. acc. pl. (poetic beside δύο)
δοιὼ: δοιώ — two; numeral, dual (indeclinable, used with a dual noun)
δοῦρε: δόρυ — spear, shaft; acc. dual, epic stem δουρ-: ’two spears’
δυοκαίδεκα: δυοκαίδεκα — twelve; numeral, indeclinable (= Attic δώδεκα)
δυσμενέεσσι: δυσμενής — hostile, ill-disposed; used as noun ’enemies’; masc. dat. pl., epic -έεσσι (= Attic δυσμενέσι)
δύω: δύο — two; numeral, epic by-form δύω, indeclinable
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
δῶμα: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (identical neut. form), subject of a verb: ’the house’
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’ · also with opt., in a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ … ὁμοφρονέοις … γένοιο) · also ὡς εἰ + opt., ’as if’ (ὡς εἰ … ἱκοίατο ’as if they had come’)
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’) · also in the idiom εἰς ὅ (κε) ’until’: εἰς ὅ κεν … μιγήῃς ’until you mingle with’
εἰσαφίκηται: εἰσαφικνέομαι — arrive at, come to; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid. (ὅτις … εἰσαφίκηται ’whoever comes to’)
εἰσορόων: εἰσοράω — look upon, gaze at; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἰσορῶν)
εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. (accented εἴ before a following enclitic, περ among them) · also introducing an indirect question, ‘whether’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ’ εἴ κέ ... ‘who knows whether’) · also with opt., of an aim in view: ’in case, to see if’ (εἴ τινά … λάβοι ’in case he might catch someone’) · also in ὡς εἴ τ’ + opt., ’as if’ · also in ὡς εἴ τε with no verb or optative expressed: ’as if’
εἴη: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’it might be, he might be’; impersonal + inf.: ’it might be possible for him’ · also in a wish with a dat. of the person: ’may there be (for us)’ (εἴη μὲν νῦν νῶϊν … ἐδωδὴ ’may there be food for us two’) · also in a wish after εἰ γάρ, ’if only (all things) were’ · also in a fear clause after μή, ’lest it be (a god)’
εἴσεαι: οἶδα — know; fut. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἴσῃ): ’you will know’
εἶπες: εἶπον (aor. of λέγω/φημί) — say, speak; aor. 2 sg.: ‘you said’ (augment fused into the diphthong, unlike unfused ἔειπες)
εὐχετόωντο: εὐχετάομαι — declare oneself, avow, boast; impf. 3 pl., epic diectasis (by-form of εὔχομαι) · also pray, make a vow: ’they prayed’ (εὐχετόωντο θεοῖσιν ’they prayed to the gods’)
εὕδοντ: εὕδω — sleep; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (εὕδοντ’ = εὕδοντα)
ζεύς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
ηὔδα: αὐδάω — speak, say; impf. 3 sg., augmented (αὐ- → ηὐ-)
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before rough breathing, cf. ἔφαθ’) — and; connective particle
θαλάμου: θάλαμος — chamber, room; masc. gen. sg.
θεοῖσι: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic θεοῖς)
θεράποντε: θεράπων — attendant, servant; masc. nom. dual
θεῖος: θεῖος — divine, god-inspired; masc. nom. sg.
θοῇ: θοός — swift, quick (standing epithet of ships); fem. dat. sg.
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (μελιηδέα θυμὸν ἀπηύρα ’took away (my) honey-sweet life’)
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
θύραζε: θύραζε — to the outside, out of doors; adv., directional suffix -δε (= -ζε after a vowel)
θῆκε: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθηκε)
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὃς δέ κ’ … ἵκηται ’whoever comes’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κ’ ἐλθὼν … εἴποιμι ’and I would go and tell’)
κάτα: κατά — down, throughout; prep. + acc., placed after its noun with anastrophe: κραναὴν Ἰθάκην κάτα ’throughout rocky Ithaca’ · also standing after its verb, not after a noun: ἔχῃ κάτα δῆμον ἅπαντα ’holds throughout the whole land’ (κατά + acc., or tmesis for κατέχῃ)
κάτθεσαν: κατατίθημι — set down, stow; aor. 3 pl., syncopated and unaugmented (= κατέθηκαν)
κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κέ τοι λύσῃ ’so that she may free’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ ποθι Ζεὺς δώῃ ’if Zeus should somehow grant’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (εἴ κέ τιν’ … εὕρωμεν ’if we should find any’) · also + opt. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ μοι … παρασταίης ’if you would stand by me’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: τῷ κέ με … ὤνησεν ’would have benefited me’ · also + fut./short-vowel aor. subj. in a main clause: κέ τοι καταλέξω ’I shall tell you’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (εἴ κέ μιν ἀγγείλαιμι ’if I might report him’) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ τοι φήνωσι ’until they show you’) · also + subj. in a prospective relative clause: ’who shall’ (ὅς κέ με κεῖσ’ ἀγάγῃ ’who shall lead me there’) · also + fut. indic. (or short-vowel subj.) in a clause after εἴ: ’whether perhaps’ (εἴ κέ σφι … τελευτήσει ’whether … it will come to pass for them’)
κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + aor. indic., unreal past: κέν μοι … κατέχευας ’you would have poured on me’ · also + subj. in a main clause: ’may’ (καί κέν οἱ ὑπέρσχῃ χεῖρα ’and he may hold his hand over him’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (κέν μοι … εἴη ’would be mine’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέν τις … ὀρέξῃ ’if perhaps someone holds out’)
κέονται: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid up; pres. 3 pl., epic (= Attic κεῖνται)
κακῶς: κακός — bad, evil; adv.: ’wickedly, shamefully’ · also ’miserably, in misery’ (ὀψὲ κακῶς ἔλθοι ’may he come late, in misery’)
καπνοῦ: καπνός — smoke; masc. gen. sg., governed by ἐκτός
κατ: κατά (elided κατ’) — down from, throughout; + gen./acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (κατ’ … ἕζετο = κατέζετο ’sat down’)
κατάλεξον: καταλέγω — recount in full and in order (not yet ’choose’, as later); aor. imper. 2 sg.
κατέλειπεν: καταλείπω — leave behind; impf. 3 sg., + acc.
καταλέξω: καταλέγω — recount in full and in order; fut. 1 sg. or aor. subj. 1 sg. (the epic forms coincide): ’I will tell in full’
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’) · also + gen., ’down from’ (κατὰ πετράων ’down from the rocks’) · also + gen., ’all over, throughout’ (κατὰ σπείους κέχυτο ’lay spread all over the cave’) · also + acc., of the part grasped: ’by’ (κατὰ νῶτα λαβών ’taking him by the back’) · also + acc., ’on account of, on the business of’ (κατὰ χρέος ’on business’) · also + gen., ’down in, within’ (κατὰ σπείους κοίλοιο δέδυκεν ’is sunk in the hollow cave’)
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … ἐποτρύνῃ ’until … urges on’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κε πίῃ) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever, as soon as’ (ὅτε … κε θάνῃσιν; ἐπεί κε … λίπῃ) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κε … ἀκούσῃς) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κε λίσσηαι ’but if you beg’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καὶ νύ κε … βάλεν ’and she would have hurled’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κε θάνωμεν ’either we may die’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κε … μαχοίμην ’I would fight’)
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … δαινύῃ ’whenever you feast’) · also + subj. in the protasis of a condition after αἴ: ’if ever’ · also + opt., potential: ’might, may’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κεν … ἀφικοίμεθα ’but if we should reach’) · also + fut. indic. or short-vowel subj. in an apodosis: ’will’ (αἶψά κεν … τεύξομεν ’at once we will build’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἴ κεν … ἵκωμαι ’if I should come’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κεν ἁλώῃ ’or he may be caught’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κεν ὀπυίῃ ’whoever marries’) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν ἔλθω ’until I come’)
κεφαλῇ: κεφαλή — head; fem. dat. sg. · also periphrasis for the person: ’Achilles himself’ (Ἀχιλλῆος κεφαλῇ, dative of the person grieved for)
κεῖται: κεῖμαι — lie; pres. 3 sg., used of the dead: ’lies (dead)’ · also in the idiom θεῶν ἐν γούνασι κεῖται: ’rests with the gods, lies in the gods’ hands’ (of an outcome, not of the dead) · also subj. (= κέηται): ’should lie’ · also plain pres. 3 sg. of stored objects: ’lies, is kept/stored’ (κειμήλια κεῖται ’treasures lie stored’) · also pres. 3 sg. of a living person in a settled, ongoing state, not of the dead nor of an outcome nor of stored goods (ὁ μὲν ἐν νήσῳ κεῖται ’πάσχων’): ’remains, is stranded, dwells on’ · also of a place, ’lies, is situated’ (νῆσος ... κεῖται ’an island lies’) · also of an object: ’lies’ (ἀράχνια κεῖται ἔχουσα ’lies holding cobwebs’)
κιὼν: κίω — go; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
κλέος: κλέος — fame, renown, report; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. (same form), direct object: μέγα κλέος ἤρατο ’won great fame’; κλέος φέρειν ’bring report’
κλαῖον: κλαίω — weep, wail; impf. 1 sg. · also impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔκλαιον): ’they wept’
κοῦροι: κοῦρος — young man, boy; nom. pl.
κρονίων: Κρονίων — son of Cronus, Zeus; masc. nom. sg., by-form of Κρονίδης
κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect (φίλον κῆρ ’in his own heart’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a verb: κῆρ ἤθελε ’my heart wished’ · also κήρ — death-fate, doom; fem. acc. sg., elided (κῆρ’ = κῆρα): ’death-fate’ (θάνατον καὶ κῆρ’ ’death and doom’)
λίην: λίαν — very much, exceedingly; adv., Ionic λίην (= Attic λίαν)
λαέρτης: Λαέρτης — Laertes, father of Odysseus; masc. nom. sg.
λείβων: λείβω — pour, let fall drop by drop; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg. (δάκρυα λείβων ’pouring tears’), kept distinct from δάκρυ χέων ’shedding a tear’
λευγαλέῳ: λευγαλέος — pitiful, sorry, miserable; masc. dat. sg.
λιγέως: λιγύς — clear-toned, clear-voiced; adv. λιγέως: ’clearly, in a ringing voice’
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάχεσθαι: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. inf. (Attic μάχεσθαι), + dat. ’fight against’
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέδων: Μέδων — Medon, herald of Odysseus’s household; masc. nom. sg.
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ (the acute μέν is kept before a following enclitic; elsewhere μὲν) · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’ (οὐ μέν ’not indeed’) · also μένω — stay, wait; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (μέν’ = μένε): ’stay’
μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, drive; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject (μένος … ἐνέστακται ’his force has been instilled’) · also neut. nom. sg. in the periphrasis ἱερὸν μένος Ἀλκινόοιο: ’the sacred strength of Alcinous’, a periphrasis for Alcinous himself
μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’) · also in a question expecting the answer ’no’, after ἦ: ἦ μή … φάσθ’ ἔμμεναι; ’surely you do not say … are?’ · also ’lest’ + subj. after a past verb of urging (κελόμην … μή … λάθηται ’I urged … lest he forget’) · also in a condition, ’if … not’ (εἰ … μή τίς σε βιάζεται) · also with an infinitive used as an imperative, a prohibition: μή μ’ … καταλείπειν ’do not leave me’ · also negating a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’so that … not’ (ἵνα μή τι … ἀλγήσετε ’so that you may not suffer’) · also with the optative, a negative wish: ’may … not’ (μή … ἀντιβολήσαις) · also ὡς ἂν μή + subj., negative purpose: ’so that … not’ (ὡς ἂν μή σε κατατρύχῃ ’so that he may not wear you out’)
μήτε: μήτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
μαλακοῖς: μαλακός — soft, gentle, mild; masc. dat. pl., with ἐπέεσσι
μεγάροισιν: μέγαρον — hall, great room, house; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν), plural for a single house
μειλιχίοις: μειλίχιος — gentle, soothing; masc. dat. pl., with ἐπέεσσιν
μερμηρίξας: μερμηρίζω — ponder, be in two minds; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having pondered’
μευ: ἐγώ — I; encl. gen. sg., epic μευ (= Attic μου): ’of me’, with κλύω ’hear me’ · also gen. with ἄγχι: ’near me’ (μευ ἄγχι στᾶσα) · also gen. of possession, ’my’ (οἵ μευ … κῆρ ’my heart’) · also gen. sg. with a participle: ’of me hearing’ (μευ ἀκούοντος, with φίλον ἦτορ ’heart’)
μεῖζον: μείζων — greater, larger; neut. nom./acc. sg., comparative of μέγας
μητίετα: μητίετα — counsellor, wise in counsel (epithet of Zeus); masc. nom. sg., epic -α
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of the person affected, ’from my …’ (μοι βλεφάρων ἐξέσσυτο ὕπνος ’sleep rushed out from my eyelids’) · also dat. of possession with εἰμί: ’who are mine’ (οἵ μοι ἔασιν ’who are mine’)
μυχὸν: μυχός — innermost part, recess; masc. acc. sg.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μὴ: μή — not; negative particle in wishes, prohibitions, and purpose/fear clauses · also negating a conditional clause after εἰ: εἰ μὴ ’if not, unless’ · also negating a generic relative clause with the opt.: ὃς μὴ … ἐλάσειε ’whoever did not drive off’
ναυσίκλυτοι: ναυσικλυτός — famed for ships, ship-renowned; masc. nom. pl.
νεφέεσσι: νέφος — cloud; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
νηῒ: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. sg., epic νηΐ (diaeresis marks the two syllables)
νοήσας: νοέω — perceive, understand; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having perceived’
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
νῶϊ: ἐγώ — I; pron., 1st pers. dual nom. ’we two’, epic (= Attic νώ)
νῶϊν: ἐγώ — I; dual gen./dat., epic (= Attic νῷν): ’for us two’
οἰκήων: οἰκεύς — household servant; masc. gen. pl., epic -ήων (= Attic οἰκέων)
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’) · also article-like with a numeral and noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’the’ (οἱ δὲ δύω σκόπελοι ’the two crags’) · also encl. dat. sg. of a thing, ’to/for it’ (δύω δέ τέ οἱ θύραι ’and it has two doors’) · also article-like with a noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’those, the’ (οἱ πέπλοι ’the robes’) · also dat. sg. of the giver with δέχομαι: ’from him’ (οἱ ἐδέξατο ’took from him’)
οἴκαδε: οἶκος — house, home; + directional suffix -δε: ’homeward, to one’s home’
οἴοισιν: οἶος — alone, only; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (= οἱ, accented οἵ in this position) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; masc. nom. pl. ’they’, demonstrative: οἵ γ’ ὑβρισταί ’are they violent?’
οἷά: οἷος — of what kind, such as; relative/exclamatory adj., neut. nom./acc. pl., with τε in a comparison: ’just as, like’ · also neut. acc. pl. relative, object of a verb: ’such things as’ (οἷά κ’ ἔχωμεν ’such as we may have’)
οἷσί: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic οἷς), accented before the enclitic περ; dat. after πέποιθε ’trusts in’
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐκέτι: οὐκέτι — no longer, not any more; adv.
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg.: ’all’ (πάντα δῆμον ’all the people’) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbial: ’altogether, in every respect’ (οὐκ ἄρα πάντα νοήμονες ’not altogether sensible’)
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv., with inf. like Attic πρίν · also a plain temporal adverb with a finite verb, not paired with an infinitive: ’formerly, in the past’ (αἳ πάρος ἦσαν ’who formerly were’)
πέρι: περί — around, about, exceedingly; adv. with anastrophe (accent thrown back): ’beyond all others’ (πέρι κέρδεα οἶδεν) · also preposition with anastrophe + acc., of place: ’around’ (ἄστυ πέρι ’around the city’)
παλλὰς: Παλλάς — Pallas, title of Athena of unknown origin (perhaps πάλλω ’brandish’); nom. sg.
παρίσταται: παρίστημι — stand beside, stand by; pres. 3 sg. mid., + dat.
πατέρ: πατήρ — father; masc. acc. sg., elided (πατέρ’ = πατέρα)
πατρὶ: πατήρ — father; masc. dat. sg., governed by ὁμοῖοι ’like’ · also masc. dat. sg. of the person told: ’to (her) father’ (ἀγγείλειε ... πατρὶ φίλῳ ’report to her dear father’) · also masc. dat. sg. in apposition to Zeus: Διὶ πατρὶ ’to father Zeus’ · also masc. dat. sg. of the god prayed to: εὔχεο πατρὶ Ποσειδάωνι ’pray to your father Poseidon’ · also masc. dat. sg. after παρά: ’beside (their) father’ (παρὰ πατρὶ φίλῳ) · also masc. dat. sg. object of χαριζόμενος: ’pleasing (his own) father’ · also masc. dat. sg. of the person one is angry at: πατρὶ χολωθείς ’angered at his father’
πεζὸν: πεζός — on foot; masc. acc. sg., predicative with the subject of an infinitive
πεπνυμένος: πέπνυμαι — have one’s wits about one, be prudent; perf. part. masc. nom. sg. (trad. linked to πνέω ’breathe’, though uncertain), stock epithet: ’prudent’
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’ · also after εἰ, ’if indeed, even if’: εἴ περ γάρ κεν ’if indeed ever’
πηνελόπεια: Πηνελόπεια — Penelope, wife of Odysseus; nom. sg.
πλέονες: πολύς — much, many; comparative πλέων/πλείων, masc. nom. pl. πλέονες: ’the greater number, most’
πολύτλας: πολύτλας — much-enduring; adj., masc. nom. sg., standing epithet of Odysseus (πολύ ’much’ + root of τλῆναι ’endure’)
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’by far’ · also neut. nom. sg. adj. agreeing with ὕδωρ: ’much, plentiful’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial with a negative: ’far’ (οὐ πολὺ ναῖεν ’did not live far off’)
πολὺν: πολύς — much, many; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration: ’for a long time’ · also adjectival, agreeing with a direct object noun: ‘much’ (πολὺν βίοτον ‘much livelihood’)
ποτε: ποτέ — once, at some time, formerly; enclitic adv.
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προτὶ: πρός (epic by-form προτί) — towards, to; prep. + acc.
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’ · also + gen., ’from, under the protection of’ (πρὸς Διός εἰσιν ’are from Zeus’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ῥαίοιτο πρὸς οὔδεϊ ’be dashed against the floor’) · also + dat., ’in addition to’ (πρὸς τοῖσί τε ὕπνος ’and sleep in addition to these’) · also + gen., of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς Βορέαο ’toward the North Wind’) · also + gen., in an appeal: ’by (your father)’ (πρὸς πατρὸς γουνάζομαι) · also as preverb in tmesis: με πρὸς μῦθον ἔειπε = με προσέειπε μῦθον ’spoke a word to me’
πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’)
πόντον: πόντος — sea, open sea; acc. sg.
σεῖο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σεῖο (= Attic σοῦ) · also gen. of comparison: σεῖο … μακάρτατος ’more blessed than you’
σπήεσσι: σπέος — cave, grotto; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic σπέσι)
στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
σφέας: σφεῖς — they; pron., masc. acc. pl., epic σφέας (= Attic σφᾶς), governed by διά: ’through them’ · also acc. pl. object of a verb of teaching: ’them’ (σφέας … ἐδίδαξε ’taught them’) · also acc. pl. reflexive object, with αὐτούς: ’themselves’ (πυκάζοιεν σφέας αὐτούς) · also acc. pl. direct object: ’them’ (Ζεὺς σφέας τίσαιτο ’may Zeus punish them’)
σφι: σφι — epic dat. pl. pron. ’to/for them’ (= Attic αὐτοῖς)
σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
σύνθεο: συντίθημι — put together; mid. take to heart, mark; aor. imper. mid. 2 sg., unaugmented, epic (= Attic σύνθου)
σὸν: σός — your, yours (sg.); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with γέρας: ’your (prize)’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also as adverb, ’together’, or as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: σὺν … κάλυψε = συνεκάλυψε ’covered up’; σὺν … ἔπεσον = συνέπεσον ’fell together, clashed’ · also adverb ’along, with (us)’ construed with ἔχοντες, which takes the object (σὺν … χεῖρας ἔχοντες ’having hands along with us’)
σῇσιν: σός — your, yours; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αῖς), agreeing with φρεσί
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’
τέκνον: τέκνον — child; neut. voc. sg. (= nom./acc. in form)
τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’ · also enclitic indefinite with a negative, ’anything’, as accusative subject of an infinitive (οὐ … τί φημι κακώτερον ἄλλο … συγχεῦαι ’I say nothing else is worse’) · also enclitic indefinite, adverbial without a negative: ’somehow, in some way’ (τοῦτό τί μοι κάλλιστον ’this seems to me somehow the fairest’) · also enclitic indefinite as an adjective after μή, accented before an enclitic: ’any’ (μή τί τοι … πῆμα ’any harm to you’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ὅπως, accented before enclitic μοι: ’any’ (τί … ἄλγος ’any pain’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ἤ, accented before the enclitic μοι: ’any’ (ἤ τί μοι … κειμήλιον ’or any treasure of mine’)
τίει: τίω — honour, hold in honour; pres. 3 sg. (long ι; = Attic τιμᾷ)
τίνες: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. pl., predicate of an infinitive · also predicate of a finite verb (εἰμί): τίνες ἐστέ; ’who are you?’ · also interrog. adj. + noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’what’ (τίνες κοῦροι)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεύχεα: τεῦχος — tool, gear, armor, equipment; neut. nom./acc. pl.
τηλέμαχος: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; nom. sg.
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’) · also ὅ τι as an adverbial acc. in an indirect question: ’why’ · also as a substantive object in a statement: ’something’ (καί τι ἴσασι ’they know something’)
τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; neut./masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα) · also fem. acc. sg. (εἴ τιν’ … λύσιν ’some release’)
τινες: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. nom. pl. (after a relative, οἵ τινες = ὅστις pl.): ’whoever’ · also indefinite ’any’ after a negative: οὔ τινες ’not any, none’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’
τοί: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also relative: ’who’ · also encl. dat. sg. pron. σύ ’to you’ (= τοι, accented before a following enclitic, e.g. τοί τι)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοιγὰρ: τοιγάρ — well then, accordingly; particle introducing a response to a request
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. pl. (ἀέθλους, τοὺς … ἐπειρήσαντο Ὀδυσῆος ’the contests with which they tried Odysseus’) · also demonstrative with a noun: masc. acc. pl. ’those, the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους … ἑταίρους ’the rest of my companions’)
τοῖον: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’in such a way’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun or pronoun: ’such a one as’ (σέ γε τοῖον ἐγείνατο ’bore a son such as you’) · also ’so’, qualifying an adj. · also neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with a neut. noun: τοῖον … ἔρνος (acc.), τοῖον … δόρυ (nom.) ’such a shoot, such a trunk’
τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’from/to them’
τροίηνδε: Τροίη — Troy; adv. form with directional suffix -δε: ‘to Troy’
τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’; may anticipate a following clause: ’this (namely that…)’ · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (φάρμακον … τό σφιν πόρε ’the drug which she gave them’)
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. sg.
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; neut. nom. pl. (μῆλα, τὰ … κατάκειτ’ ’the flocks, which lie’) · also relative, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’, object of the verb in its clause (ῥωγαλέα, τὰ … ὅρηαι ’torn, which you see’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’) · also demonstrative, distributive: masc. acc. sg. ’the one … the other’ (τὸν μὲν … τὸν δ’) · also article-like with a participle: τὸν ἐόντα ’me, the one who am’ · also article-like with a superlative or ordinal: ’the best’ (τὸν ἄριστον), ’the fourth’ (τὸν τέταρτον)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’ · also with a noun, article-like: τῶν ἄλλων ἀνέμων ’of the other winds’ · also distributive, ’of the one … of the other’ (τῶν μὲν … τῶν δ’ ’of the one band … of the other’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: gen. pl. ’of whom, whose’ (τῶν ὕβρις τε βίη τε … ἵκει ’whose insolence and violence reach’)
φάος: φάος — light (epic uncontracted = Attic φῶς); neut. nom./acc. sg.
φίλε: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. voc. sg.
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: φίλον υἱόν ’dear son’ · also masc. acc. sg. predicative, agreeing with a pronoun: ’as a friend, welcome’ (φίλον ἐλθεῖν)
φαινομένηφιν: φαίνομαι — appear, show oneself; pres. part. (dat. sg. sense) φαινομένηφιν, the rare -φι(ν) suffix, elsewhere confined to nouns, attached here unusually to a participle: ’(Dawn) as she appears’ — a genuinely rare formation
φράζευ: φράζω — mid. think out, devise, plan; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -ευ (= Attic -ου): ’devise! plan!’
φράσσομαι: φράζομαι — take thought, consider, devise; fut. 1 sg. (or short-vowel aor. subj.), epic σσ: ’I will take thought’
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
φῆναι: φαίνω — show, reveal, bring to light; aor. inf. φῆναι: ’to show’
φῶτες: φώς — man, hero; masc. nom. pl.
χρόνον: χρόνος — time; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration
ἀγλαὰ: ἀγλαός — splendid, shining, glorious; adj., neut. acc. pl. (ἀγλαὰ δῶρα ’splendid gifts’)
ἀγορεύεις: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare, say; pres. 2 sg.
ἀείρας: ἀείρω — lift, raise (Attic αἴρω); aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having lifted’
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀθανάτοισι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -οις)
ἀθηναίη: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. nom. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη)
ἀληθείην: ἀλήθεια — truth; fem. acc. sg. (Ionic ἀληθείη)
ἀλλήλους: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. acc. pl.
ἀμφοτέροισι: ἀμφότερος — both (of two); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἀμφὶς: ἀμφίς — apart, on both sides, around; adverb
ἀμύμονα: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (traditional sense; exact meaning uncertain); adj., fem. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg.: ἀμύμονα Λαοδάμαντα ’blameless Laodamas’
ἀνέρες: ἀνήρ — man; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄνδρες)
ἀνδράσι: ἀνήρ — man; masc. dat. pl., epic ἀνδράσι
ἀνθρώπους: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; acc. pl.
ἀντίον: ἀντίον — face to face, in answer, opposite; adv.
ἀοιδὸς: ἀοιδός — minstrel, singer; masc. nom. sg.
ἀποτίσεαι: ἀποτίνω — pay back; mid. exact payment for, avenge; fut. 2 sg. mid., epic -εαι (= Attic ἀποτίσῃ)
ἀριθμόν: ἀριθμός — number, count, total; masc. acc. sg.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἂν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also with a secondary indicative (impf./aor.) marking an unreal, contrary-to-fact conclusion: ’would’ (οὐκ ἂν ... ἀγόρευες ’you would not be speaking’) · also = ἀνά (preposition/preverb ’up’) in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἂν … βαῖνε = ἀνέβαινε, ἂν … βάντες = ἀναβάντες) · also = ἀνά as a preposition + acc.: ’up through, up among’ (ἂν δόνακας ’up through the reeds’)
ἂρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, grave form ἂρ (ἐπεὶ ἂρ δή ’since, as it seems’)
ἄγαγον: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἤγαγον): ’I brought’
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄγη: ἄγη — amazement, wonder (rare noun, cf. ἄγαμαι); fem. nom. sg.
ἄγοντες: ἄγω — lead, bring; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’bringing, leading’
ἄκουον: ἀκούω — hear; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἤκουον)
ἄκουσον: ἀκούω — hear, listen; aor. imper. 2 sg., + gen.: ’hear (me)’
ἄλλο: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἄλλοις: ἄλλος — other, another; masc./neut. dat. pl.
ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg.
ἄλλους: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. pl.
ἄνδρε: ἀνήρ — man; masc. nom. dual: ’two men’
ἄνευθ: ἄνευθε(ν) (elided ἄνευθ’) — far off, apart, away; adv.
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἄριστοι: ἄριστος — best; superl., masc. nom. pl.
ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time as; adv./prep. + dat.
ἐγώ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. (accented ἐγώ before the enclitic τοι that follows) · also accented ἐγώ before the enclitic μιν that follows
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐείκοσι: εἴκοσι — twenty; numeral, indeclinable, epic prothetic ἐ- (ἐείκοσι = εἴκοσι)
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐλεεινὸν: ἐλεεινός — pitiable, wretched; neut. acc. sg.
ἐλθών: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἐμεῖο: ἐγώ — I; epic gen. sg. ἐμεῖο (= Attic ἐμοῦ)
ἐμοῖσι: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic ἐμοῖς)
ἐμός: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. nom. sg.
ἐμὸν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’my’ (ὄνομ’ … ἐμὸν ’my name’; ἐμὸν κῆρ ’my heart’)
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐναλίγκιον: ἐναλίγκιος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with the speaker: ’like (a beggar)’
ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — here, to this place; adv.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐπέεσσι: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἔπεσι)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’) · also adverb of sequence, ’next, thereupon’ (ἦλθε δ’ ἐπὶ ψυχή ’and next came the soul’) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: ἐπὶ … τέταλτο = ἐπιτέταλτο ’was laid upon, entrusted’ · also + acc. of time: ’for, over’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + dat., ’in charge of, over’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσιν ’over my possessions’)
ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσθλὸν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; neut./masc. acc. sg.
ἐσθῆτά: ἐσθής — clothing, raiment; fem. acc. sg.
ἐσσι: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
ἐτεόν: ἐτεός — true, real; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’truly, really’ (εἰ ἐτεόν γε ’if indeed truly’)
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc./neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ὄντα)
ἐόντος: εἰμί — be; pres. part. gen. sg., epic (= Attic ὄντος): ’being, alive’
ἐόντων: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc./neut. gen. pl., epic (= Attic ὄντων): ’of (those) being’ (θεῶν αἰὲν ἐόντων ’of the gods who are forever’)
ἐῴκει: ἔοικα — be like, resemble; plpf. with impf. force, 3 sg.
ἑλέσθαι: αἱρέω — take, take up; aor. mid. inf.: ’to take (for oneself)’
ἑλοίμεθα: αἱρέω — take; mid. choose; aor. opt. mid. 1 pl. (stem ἑλ-), potential with κεν: ’we would choose’
ἔασιν: εἰμί — be; epic pres. 3 pl. (= Attic εἰσίν): ’are’
ἔδυ: δύω — go in, sink, set (of the sun); aor. 3 sg. (root aorist)
ἔμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔνδον: ἔνδον — within, inside, at home; adv. (distinct from the by-form ἔνδοθι, also ’within’)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔριν: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contention; fem. acc. sg.
ἔρχευ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; imper. 2 sg., epic ἔρχευ (= Attic ἔρχου)
ἠελίοιο: Ἠέλιος — the Sun (god); gen. sg., epic (-οιο = Attic Ἡλίου)
ἠμὲν: ἠμέν — both (epic correlative, ἠμέν … ἠδέ ’both … and’); conj.
ἠοῖ: ἠώς — dawn; fem. dat. sg. ἠοῖ
ἡμετέροιο: ἡμέτερος — our; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἡμῖν: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; dat. pl. ’to us’
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic ἠέ/ἤ) · also ’than’ after a comparative: κρεῖσσον … ἢ ὅτε ’better than when’ · also ’before’ after a verb of anticipating (ἔφθης … ἢ ἐγώ ’you got here before I did’) · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἔτι … ἦέ τις ’whether still … or someone’) · also ’than’ after a verb of preferring: βουλοίμην … ἢ … ἀνάσσειν ’I would rather … than rule’
ἤ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj., accented before an enclitic (ἤ κεν); ἤ … ἦε ’whether … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative: μεῖζον … ἤ ’greater than’
ἤγαγον: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. 3 pl., reduplicated · also aor. 1 sg. (the same ending serves both persons): ’I brought’ (ἤγαγον ἐκ Σκύρου ’I brought him from Scyros’)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’) · also ’or’, the second alternative of a pair of questions with no preceding ἠέ: ζώει … ἦ τέθνηκε ’alive or dead’; ἢ ἔτ’ ἔχει … ἦ μιν ἀτιμάζουσιν ’whether … or’
ἦέ: ἠέ — or; disjunctive conj., epic by-form (variant accentuation ἦε)
ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἰθάκην: Ἰθάκη — Ithaca, Odysseus’ island home; acc. sg.
ἰθύν: ἰθύς (noun) — a direct course, an undertaking, a purpose; fem. acc. sg., distinct from the homographic adverb ἰθύς ’straight’
ἰότητι: ἰότης — will, wish, favour; fem. dat. sg.: ’by the will of’
ἱκέσθαι: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, arrive at; aor. inf.
ἱκόμην: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive; aor. mid. 1 sg., unaugmented: ’I came’
ἴστω: οἶδα — know; perf. imper. 3 sg.: ’let it/him/her know’ (calling something to witness)
ἵκετ: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented and elided (ἵκετ’ = ἵκετο) · also augmented, with the long ι that the metre needs (ἵκετ’ ἐμὸν δῶ ’came to my house’)
ὀΐομαι: ὀΐω — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. mid., epic ὀΐομαι: ’I think’ (+ acc. and inf.)
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆος)
ὀδύρετο: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn; impf. 3 sg. mid.
ὀφρύσι: ὀφρύς — eyebrow, brow; fem. dat. pl., epic -υσι (= Attic -ύσι)
ὁμίλει: ὁμιλέω — keep company with, associate with; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, + dat. · also pres. imper. 2 sg., + dat., the identical unaugmented form: ’mingle, keep company with!’ (μνηστῆρσιν ὁμίλει)
ὁππότε: ὁππότε (Attic ὁπότε) — whenever, when; conj., + subj. and κε in a general temporal clause · also introducing an indirect question, + pres. indic.: ’when’ (ὁππότε Τηλέμαχος νεῖτ(αι) ’when Telemachus is to return’) · also + subj. without κε, in a general clause: ’whenever’ (ὁππότε τις μνήσῃ ’whenever anyone mentions’)
ὁπότε: ὁπότε — whenever, when; temporal conj., + opt. in a general/iterative clause
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj. · also temporal ’until’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἵκετ’ Ἀρήτην ’until he came to Arete’) · also ’until’ + ἄν and subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἵκηαι ’until you reach’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary verb: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … μένοιεν) · also temporal ’until’ + opt., of a hoped-for event (ὄφρ’ ἐξεμέσειεν ’until she should vomit out’)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. (ὄφρα ... βάλε): marking the point an action ceases · also temporal + subj. with κε, correlative with τόφρα: ’as long as, until’ (ὄφρα κε κείνη τοῦτον ἔχῃ νόον ’for as long as she holds this purpose’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary-sequence verb: ὄφρα ... ἕλοις/ἵκοιο ’so that you might take/arrive’ · also temporal + indic., ’as long as’ (ὄφρα μὲν … ἦν ’so long as it was’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅσσα: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος (double σ), neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’as many as’
ὅσσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος, masc. nom. pl.: ’as many as’ (correlative with τόσσοι)
ὅσσον: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much/great as; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, correlative with τόσσον: ’as far as’ · also in an indirect exclamation, ’how greatly’ (ὅσσον ἄρισται ’how excellent they are’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν, in an indirect exclamation: ’how great (a host)’
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’) · also with the optative, iterative in past time: ’whenever’ (ὅτε μέλλοι ’whenever he was about to’) · also with the pres. indic., ’whereas, when’ (ὅτε τ’ ἄλλοι ἅπαξ θνῄσκουσ’ ἄνθρωποι ’whereas other men die only once’) · also in ὅτε μή, ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ θεὸς … θείη ’unless a god should make’)
ὅτις: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; masc. nom. sg., epic (ὅτις = Attic ὅστις)
ὑμῖν: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; dat. pl.: ’to you’
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; prep. + gen.; also + acc., ’under, up under’ · also of agent with a verb of dying, ‘by, at the hands of’ + gen. (ὤλεθ’ ὑπ’ Αἰγίσθοιο ‘perished by Aegisthus’) · also + dat., ’under, beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb, no case governed: οὓς ὑπ’ Ὀδυσσεὺς δύσετ’ = ὑπεδύσετο ’underneath which Odysseus sank down’
ὑπερφιάλοισιν: ὑπερφίαλος — overweening, arrogant; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ὑφ: ὑπό (elided ὑφ’, before a rough breathing) — under, beneath; + gen., dat. or acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (ὑφ’ ... ὦρσε = ὑπῶρσε ’aroused’)
ὑφαντήν: ὑφαντός — woven; fem. acc. sg. (ἐσθῆτα ὑφαντήν ’woven clothing’)
ὕστερον: ὕστερος — later, latter; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’afterwards’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’ · also in an asseveration with fut. indic., ’as surely as’ (ὡς οὐκ ὀφθαλμόν γ’ ἰήσεται ’as surely as nothing will heal the eye’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. with a finite verb: ’how (dear) he is’ (ὡς ὅδε … φίλος … ἐστίν) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., of manner: ’as’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I shall say’) · also comparative ’like’, standing before its noun (ὡς νυκτερίς ’like a bat’) · also ὡς ὅθ’ (= ὡς ὅτε), ’as when’, comparing with an occasion in the past (ὡς ὅθ’ ὑπὸ Τροίην ’as when beneath Troy’) · also introducing an indirect statement after a verb of saying: ’that, how’ (εἴποιμ’ ὡς … ἔρχομαι ’I might tell how I am coming’) · also ὡς ἄν + opt., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἄν τίς σε … μακαρίζοι ’so that someone … would call you blessed’) · also ὡς + participle, ’as one who’ (ὡς ἐκ θανάτοιο φυγόντα ’as one escaped from death’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν … ἔρχησθον ’so that you two may go’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὦρτο: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse; mid./intr. aor. 3 sg. ὦρτο, root aorist: ’arose’ (of a wind springing up) · also of a person: ’set out, started’ (ὦρτο πόλινδ’ ἴμεν ’set out to go to the city’)
